Before The Process

The Core Principles Of Agency Sales

This is not a Wolf of Wall Street approach to selling.
You are an advisor, a consultant, a subject matter expert.

Some deals close on one call, some take a year.
Always maintain a good relationship and good communication.

You are not selling services, you are selling results.
The faster, the better.

Do not get emotional about deals.
The best deal is always the next one.

The role of marketing is to generate interest.
The role of sales is to generate leads.

Your conversion point is the pre call step.
We call it your macro conversion page.

The offer should make visitors want

Discovery Call

The first conversation with a prospect.

Qualifying leads with questions

It helps to collect info ahead of the call. This not only lets you filter out garbage leads, but prepare for the call (will demonstrate).

Moving the lead to the next stage

The goal here is to collect enough information and get buy in to move to the analysis stage.

Running the consultation

Over the shoulder look at how to run killer discovery calls with prospects.

"Have An Idea, Son"

Preparing For The Call

15 minutes before the call, set up your notes file in advance.

Drop the website into a crawler if there is time, and into Ahrefs or Semrush, to get context for the site. One to three recommendations.

Review their intake form and take some initial notes on your thoughts. Be thinking about issues and solutions the whole time, so you position yourself as a trusted leader.

Make sure to record your Zoom or Meet with the prospect, so it can automatically be added to Agency OS.

8

BUILDING PROPOSALS

A deep look into issues and opportunities.

Start with client notes

Using the questions during the sales call to formulate an initial plan of attack based on what they want.

Full website crawl in ScreamingFrog

To find the technical and structural roadblocks holding the site back, and to offer solutions for them.

KWs, content and links opportunities

Use Ahrefs (or SEMrush) to find untapped keywords, low hanging fruit content and link opportunities.

Topical analysis

Use Ahrefs (or SEMrush) to find untapped keywords, low hanging fruit content and link opportunities.

Local analysis in Local Falcon

Run the map pack grids to see where they show up across the service area, not just at the pin.

Performance across AI search

Check how often answer engines cite them, and who gets cited instead. It is a different index to the one Google ranks.

The Proposal Call

Walking the deck you built in Agency OS, slide by slide.

Understanding of their problem

Slide by slide through the analysis. That is where all of the deep work you did comes into play.

Your expertise

The same analysis, plus your ability to talk through their problems in their own language.

A clear plan to solve them

The scope of work from your prep and the proposal is the plan. Walk them through it.

Clear pricing

Easy to understand, with nothing to decode. Price confusion is how deals stall.

Expectation of results

From the forecast, client case studies, and your experience with similar businesses.

Follow Up + Close

Closing the deal.

Set the next step before the call ends

Either book another call, or ask when you can expect a decision. Your follow ups run off that date.

Follow up until you get a real answer

Keep going until it is a yes or a no. Use Agency OS to surface the leads worth chasing.

Always be kind

No matter how frustrating the prospect is. Deals come back around on timing, pricing, or a bad agency.
